verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a turbo-versus-quality mode for its heygen-video-1 prompt-to-video model and lets users review Video Agent storyboards before generating, which loosely covers a fast draft step. Nothing shows that the fast mode is cheaper, or that a chosen draft take can be upscaled to final quality rather than regenerated. 4K export is a resolution tier, not an upscale of a draft. missing for 10: documented cheaper draft pricing or credits, an upscale or promote-take-to-final workflow, take selection carried from draft to final, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: text or image to 5–30 s clips with turbo/quality enhancement
Review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and iterate with the Video Agent before generating.
